Gogi Chen Thai Tong
May 2026 • Friends
We were a group of over 40 people who booked a restaurant and had lunch at the gogi house of Chen Thi Tong. Choose a 499k ticket for more seafood and a comfortable bite... I chose it because it was near where we moved . But I'm really unhappy, I won't come back close. 
T eating gogi in Aone Ha Dong a couple of dozen times, not to disappoint me. 
Because you are guests, you serve 1 meat, 1 mandu cake + rolled rice and 2 coke pots per table. Remember, add a 4c shrimp/table and keep calling, add a dish of 4 pieces cattle ribs, and a dish of 4 pieces stone shrimp and 2 tables 😆 Generally calling is long and long. The salad of tuna I had a hundred times r it pale brown. Here is a black tuna salad with lots of peanuts . Or does a new restaurant change a taste I don't know??? I have no opinion about you running the table because the b's run very hard and serve with enthusiasm. The bag here is bad kitchen, and the bag doesn't come out. 
It was not my first time eating gogi, I believed in baked meat. I say goodbye to sumo to go to gogi, but we don't want to go back.

Good ingedients prepared tastelessly
Dec 2019 • Couples
Starting with large portions of imported US Prime beef is a commendable start. Providing no preparation and serving them without any taste is a travesty. The frozen slices were brought to the table to be cooked on the grill without any marinade or seasoning (not even salt!) resulted in them having very little taste. The minimal side dishes consisted of an individual serving bowl of kimchee, a bowl of grilled onions, a small portion of dipping sauce, and lettuce and sesame seed leaves for wrapping. All in all a totally unsatisfying meal.

We had eaten in a couple of competing restaurants 50 meters up the street. If you are looking for a tasty meal, at a similar price, you will be better served to pass this place by.
